newsitem.title: UK: UK to auction 3.5 bln stg of gilts next week.
newsitem.headline: UK to auction 3.5 bln stg of gilts next week.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Tuesday it will auction 2.0 billion stg of 7.0 percent gilts due 2001 and 1.5 billion stg of 8.0 percent stock due 2015.
The auctions will take place on October 22 and 24.
The Bank said both issues will be fully paid and fungible with the relevant stocks already in issue and the 2015 stock will be strippable when a strips facility is introduced.

Price payable on application per 100 stg nominal of stock will be increased by an amount equal to the accrued interest from respective last interest payment dates May 6, 1996 at the rate of 3.26027 per 100 stg for the 7.0 percent stock due 2001 and 3.06849 per 100 stg for the 8.0 percent stock due 2015.
